# v8.0.0 — Module 8: Optimization, Sustainability, and Technology

This release completes the eight-module practitioner-oriented supply-chain learning series, including the final optimization, sustainability and technology module with its end-to-end AlderGate capstone.

## Included

- 42 independently authored Module 8 lessons: 12 in Section A, 12 in Section B and 18 in Section C
- 42 original section-review questions and 42 lesson questions, plus five capstone self-checks (**89 answered Module 8 checks**)
- 45 original accessible SVG diagrams, including three capstone graphics
- 47 fictional CSV datasets, including six additional capstone inputs
- AlderGate scenario workbook-style CSV inputs, student assignment, fully worked solution, five-year NPV sensitivity, sustainability and qualification gates, project/change/maintenance decisions, and independent calculation replays
- Reference registers and learning navigation integrated with the preceding seven modules

## Validated quality and preservation

- Shared v8.0.0 full-repository gate expects 423 module learning/reference Markdown files, 295 original SVGs, 148 fictional CSVs and 812 answered assessments.
- Previous Modules 1–7 remain separately validated against their exact 369 Markdown, 250 SVG, 101 CSV and 723 answer-block baseline.
- Owner reviewed the 45 diagrams and learning content without reporting issues, and explicitly waived an additional independent reviewer. **No external certification, copyright/plagiarism determination or professional guarantee is claimed.**
- This release follows the separately owner-authorized [merged PR #17](https://github.com/theleanx/SupplyChain-Design-Notes/pull/17).
- The repository does not redistribute the proprietary APICS/ASCM Learning System, slides, flashcards or examination question bank.
